mechanism: Duloxetine inhibits platelet aggregation via serotonin reuptake inhibition, and zoledronic acid may increase bleeding risk through osteoclast inhibition affecting hemostasis; both drugs can impair renal function independently.
action: Monitor for signs of bleeding and renal function; ensure adequate hydration during zoledronic acid infusion; consider hemoglobin/hematocrit monitoring; assess bleeding risk versus benefit of duloxetine continuation.
